what: Kit behaviour fixes for the primitive findings of expression cycle 16 and the gaps of v3-expr-15-kit-fixes that landed in part, with no export and no contract change.
owns: packages/basalt-ui/docs/** generated from the above (through gen-docs)
change: (1) Text the kit draws is never ellipsised at 390 (P2 .16, .24): a `phone: 'columns'` table's headers fit whole (n77: 'Landed' and 'Failed' cut to 'Lan...' and 'Fail...'; its builder found that `width: 'content'` on the entity column frees the room, so the column plan should do that itself), a `StatGroup` or `StatCell` error cause wraps inside its cell (n78 'Gateway timed out', 'Counter unreachable'; probe: n73 round 0's 'The server did not answer'), and a delta pill keeps its base label whole or steps down (n78 `?fixture=backlog` 'vs prior 30 d'). Reproduce on the cycle-16 round-0 source in `.evidence/v3-shots/expression-16/src-r0/n77` and `n78`, since round 1 shortened the text. (2) A `Heatmap` given `tickCols` places the ticks it adds at an even step, or adds none (P2 .17, .25: n77 at 390 names Nov 7, 9, 11, 14, 17, 20; n78 at 1800 asked for weekly ticks and drew Oct 22, 29, Nov 1, 5, 12, 16, 19). Fix the thinning without a new prop; if one is needed, stop and file a Spec row. (3) Bar value and end labels: the focus guide does not strike a focused bar's value label and a focused 390 chart keeps its x labels (n75 .2, '4 · 3.4%'); at 390 a value is kept where the bar has room and two values keep apart (n76 .9: 5 of 24 hourly values, '300' against '334'); a line end label moved off its end draws a leader and is not struck by another line at 390 (n79 .27, `?fixture=surge`; probe: n74); and the probe's open label gaps: n70's '100 %' at 390, n64's '92' under 'Gateway down' at 1800, n67's clamped caret value at 390, n68's and n71's zone captions over bars. (4) Dots at 390: a zone caption keeps off the dots, a direct label is kept or moved rather than dropped, and `spread` separates a dense column (probe: n72). (5) A stretched card or a short column puts its extra height below its content: n70's ledger (about 165 px), n71's inset (55 px) and the band between two right-hand cards beside a taller one (n76 .11, `?fixture=finished`, 47 px). (6) The dim reads on an ink-step bar series: when one bar takes the focus the others visibly recede (n75 .3, n76 .10: 0 bars dimmed in every SWEEP line; an ink-step fill at `dimmedPaint`'s floor looks as at rest). (7) At 390 the arrow keys keep the focused chart in view (n78 .19, n80 .38; probe: n73; open since cycle 14). (8) An x hover chip covers no tick label, its own included (n80 .37: 'US$0.015' over the 'US$0.015' tick at 1800 and 390, which failed the quality matrix's hover guard and is waived in apps/playground/src/cycle/expression-16/known.ts; probe: n67's '18 Aug' over '17 Aug'; n76's builder saw it): remove n80 from known.ts with the fix. (9) Defects of shipped parts that one case met: a loading skeleton of a `DataPanel` rows body ends at the ready height at 390 (n77 .14: phone-card skeletons taller than the loaded list); a non-zero `BarList` part keeps a visible minimum width (n76 .8: three failures as 1 to 2 px slivers); a `Heatmap` legend swatch draws the glyph its state cells draw (n77 .13); a `DataTable` inside a `DataPanel` keeps its own scroll box at 390 rather than running 200 phone cards down the page (n75 .5: probe first); a grouped `DataTable` tints its whole group header and leaves no blank band under it at 390 (n80 .41: probe first); no stray ellipsis beside a delta pill at 1800 (probe: n74 `?fixture=runaway`). (10) The probe's other open gaps: at 390 the next phone card of a list that shares a chart's focus takes it on arrival (n52); a focused Heatmap cell keeps its label in its ring (n57); a held run scrolls into view where it fits (n61); a phone card's id is mono (n61).
